Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: No digital identity system in place. World Bank 2024 report states country must 'strengthen the foundational identification system and establish an operational trust framework for digital authentication.' No e-signature platform exists. Biometric enrollment drive for public servants launched in 2023 but not a full digital ID ecosystem.

Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: Digital financial services (DFS) in Equatorial Guinea are still in early/nascent stages. No licensed e-money operator as per CEMAC requirements. First mobile money product launched only in mid-2023. Digital payments not integrated with government services.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Personal Data Protection Law No. 1/2016 exists. Internet Communication Law No. 1/2017 regulates digital communications. However, critical laws for data interoperability/sharing framework, cybercrime, and e-commerce are absent or outdated. World Bank highlights that data interoperability and sharing frameworks still need to be introduced.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: ADIGE has a roadmap for mobile/internet coverage extension, ICT training, and digitalization incentives but no specific implementation roadmap for data exchange or interoperability. World Bank recommends developing such a roadmap. Currently under development.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: National Development Plan 2035 includes technology and innovation as cross-cutting theme. Digital Agenda for Equatorial Guinea (ADIGE) is a strategic plan with 4 objectives including digitizing administrative procedures. However, no comprehensive strategy specifically for data exchange or interoperability. The World Bank recommends developing a national strategy for digital public platforms.

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: No operational data exchange system confirmed. World Bank 2024 diagnostic explicitly states: 'There is no interoperability platform (or a data exchange layer).' CNIAPGE (national agency for public sector digitalization) was planned as a one-stop-shop but is facing difficulties. Ministries are developing digital systems in silos.
